name: 01534 · Northbridge, MA
findings: ZIP 01534 (Northbridge) has 9 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01534 (Northbridge) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
